t: AMPA receptor - Wikipedia
s: October 28, 2025 - AMPARs are composed of four types of subunits encoded by different genes, designated as GRIA1 (GluA1 or GluR1), GRIA2 (GluA2 or GluR2), GRIA3 (GluA3 or GluR3), and GRIA4 (GluA4 or GluRA-D2), which combine to form a tetrameric structure.
